verses.text: Look well unto thyself, and beware that thou judge not the doings of others.
verses.modernizedText: Look carefully to yourself, and beware of judging the actions of others.

verses.text: In judging others a man laboureth in vain; he often erreth, and easily falleth into sin; but in judging and examining himself he always laboureth to good purpose.
verses.modernizedText: In judging others a person labors in vain; he often errs and easily falls into sin. But in judging and examining himself he always labors to good purpose.

verses.text: According as a matter toucheth our fancy, so oftentimes do we judge of it; for easily do we fail of true judgment because of our own personal feeling.
verses.modernizedText: We often judge a matter according to how it strikes our fancy, for we easily fail to judge truly because of our own personal feeling.

verses.text: If God were always the sole object of our desire, we should the less easily be troubled by the erring judgment of our fancy.
verses.modernizedText: If God were always the sole object of our desire, we would be less easily troubled by the mistaken judgment of our fancy.

verses.text: But often some secret thought lurking within us, or even some outward circumstance, turneth us aside.
verses.modernizedText: But often some secret thought lurking within us, or even some outward circumstance, turns us aside.

verses.text: Many are secretly seeking their own ends in what they do, yet know it not.
verses.modernizedText: Many are secretly seeking their own ends in what they do, yet do not know it.

verses.text: They seem to live in good peace of mind so long as things go well with them, and according to their desires, but if their desires be frustrated and broken, immediately they are shaken and displeased.
verses.modernizedText: They seem to live in good peace of mind as long as things go well for them and according to their desires, but if their desires are frustrated and broken, they are immediately shaken and displeased.

verses.text: Diversity of feelings and opinions very often brings about dissensions between friends, between countrymen, between religious and godly men.
verses.modernizedText: Differences of feelings and opinions very often bring about disagreements between friends, between countrymen, and between religious and godly people.

verses.text: Established custom is not easily relinquished, and no man is very easily led to see with the eyes of another.
verses.modernizedText: Established custom is not easily given up, and no one is very easily led to see through another’s eyes.

verses.text: If thou rest more upon thy own reason or experience than upon the power of Jesus Christ, thy light shall come slowly and hardly; for God willeth us to be perfectly subject unto Himself, and all our reason to be exalted by abundant love towards Him.
verses.modernizedText: If you rest more on your own reason or experience than on the power of Jesus Christ, your light will come slowly and with difficulty; for God wills us to be perfectly subject to Himself and all our reason to be exalted by abundant love toward Him.
